title: How to Properly Recycle Kitchen Waste
steps: Collect peelings, trimmings, coffee grounds, eggshells, and leftover vegetable matter.
Separate biodegradable kitchen waste from plastics and metals.
Use a compost bin or municipal composting facility.
Ensure waste is free from plastic or non-biodegradable items.
Compost kitchen waste into rich organic matter for gardens.
Share this process with family and neighbors to promote sustainable disposal.
Advocate for responsible kitchen waste disposal.
precautions: Do not compost oils, fats, or dairy unless specifically allowed.
Do not use plastic bags in compost bins.
Store waste in covered containers to prevent pests.
Keep kitchen waste away from children and pets.
